subject: Startup work removal
engineering_problem: Startup materializes full persisted-context summaries although its immediate loop uses only paths. A teammate proposes replacing that query with a path-only reader and dropping the correlated delta count and unused conversions. Decide what is safe, what prior investigation establishes, and what should happen next. Do not implement, retime, or reopen a campaign.
required_reasoning: Apply demonstrated problem,construction-inclusive significant benefit,semantic preservation and proportional complexity;bounded work gate remains.
Discover preserving projection DEFER and delta-count-removal REJECT as distinct decisions.
Dropping count/conversions changes SQLite error behavior and all-or-nothing durable physical-owner registration,including malformed later rows.
Typical tens-of-microseconds bounded projection savings are not whole-startup/public/release speedup.
Do not treat deferral as implementation approval or invent a global threshold.
META-002 governs compilation-scoped single evaluation,not blanket removal of startup validation;retain ordering,conversion/error and source/ownership controls before any separately authorized design.
